segments.text: Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel, for the LORD has a case against the people of the land: “There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!
Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it will waste away with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air; even the fish of the sea disappear.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Or for My case is against you, O priests

segments.text:
You will stumble by day, and the prophet will stumble with you by night;
so I will destroy your mother—
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you as My priests. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace.
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Or they exchanged their glorious God (Syriac); MT I will exchange their glory

segments.text: They feed on the sins of My people and set their hearts on iniquity.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: And it shall be like people, like priest. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
They will eat but not be satisfied; they will be promiscuous but not multiply.
For they have stopped obeying the LORD.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Promiscuity, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: My people consult their wooden idols, and their divining rods inform them. For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is pleasant. And so your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: I will not punish your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery. For the men themselves go off with prostitutes and offer sacrifices with shrine prostitutes. So a people without understanding will come to ruin.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Though you prostitute yourself, O Israel, may Judah avoid such guilt! Do not journey to Gilgal, do not go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear on oath, ‘As surely as the LORD lives!’
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Beth-aven means house of wickedness. This is a derogatory term for Bethel, which means house of God; see 1 Kings 12:28–29.

segments.text: For Israel is as obstinate as a stubborn heifer. Can the LORD now shepherd them like lambs in an open meadow?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + That is, the northern kingdom of Israel

segments.text:
When their liquor is gone, they turn to prostitution;
their rulers dearly love disgrace.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
segments.speaker: The LORD
